description: This Java class provides utility methods for performing CRUD operations and validation related to DeliveryPerson objects within a database. It includes methods for validating login credentials, inserting new delivery persons, updating their information, and deleting them, primarily used in servlets for a grocery ordering system.

classes.name: DeliveryPersonDBUtil
classes.description: A utility class for database operations related to DeliveryPerson entities, including validation, insertion, updating, and deletion.

methods.name: validateDeliveryPerson
methods.description: Validates delivery person's credentials based on email and password, returning a DeliveryPerson object if valid.

methods.name: insertDeliveryPerson
methods.description: Inserts a new delivery person record into the database, creating entries in both the employee and delivery person tables.

methods.name: updateDP
methods.description: Updates delivery person and employee details including vehicle number, city, email, image URL, phone, and password.

methods.name: deleteDeliveryPerson
methods.description: Deletes a delivery person record from both delivery person and employee tables based on EmID.

methods.name: updateDPWithoutImage
methods.description: Updates delivery person and employee details without updating the image URL.
